name: Tanbi na Kusari
source:
Rei Takanashi find a job at a male revue club "Eden".
After a while he comes to live together with one of his coworkers.
His new life with a man begins in this red light district...
(English description from DLsite)
translation:
小鸟游Rei在一家名为“伊甸”的男子歌舞俱乐部找到工作。
一段时间后，他开始与一名同事共同生活。
在这片红灯区，与男人相伴的全新生活就此展开……
（英文简介摘自DLsite）
